english.title: Border security - wilfully fail to comply with duty imposed by Schedule 3 - hostile activity
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), wilfully failed to comply with a duty imposed under or by virtue of Part 1 of Schedule 3 to the Counter Terrorism and Border-Security Act 2019, in that **(..SPECIFY DETAILS..)
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 23(1)(a) and (2) of Schedule 3 to the Counter-Terrorism and Border Security Act 2019.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Proceedings for this offence require the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions, paragraph 23(4) of Schedule 3 to the Act.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), the defendant wilfully failed to comply with a duty imposed under or by virtue of Part 1 of Schedule 3 to the Counter Terrorism and Border-Security Act 2019, in that **(..SPECIFY DETAILS..).

other.penalty:
Summary: 3 months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level 4 on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 monthsNote
When section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 (alteration of penalties for certain summary offences: England and Wales) comes into force, the reference to 3 months is to be read as a reference 51 weeks.
